physical_entity_node_group_memberships.qualification_evidence: Trail Operations is Canada's only producer of germanium and North America's only commercial-scale primary germanium recovery facility, refining germanium-bearing residues into germanium dioxide (and tetrachloride); the only supplier of germanium dioxide to the United States. Sources: https://www.teck.com/news/news-releases/2026/teck,-canada-growth-fund-and-canada-critical-minerals-accelerator-sign-agreement-to-support-strategic-metals-production-at-trail-smelter ; https://payneinstitute.mines.edu/the-north-american-germanium-supply-chain-military-applications-and-civilian-competition/ ; https://pubs.usgs.gov/periodicals/mcs2025/mcs2025-germanium.pdf

One of the world's largest fully integrated zinc and lead smelting/refining complexes; electrolytic zinc production (roast-leach-electrowin + direct pressure leaching) and a KIVCET lead smelter, ~295,000 t/yr refined zinc nameplate. Sources: https://www.teck.com/products/zinc/ ; https://www.canadianminingjournal.com/featured-article/green-lead-removes-tarnish/

owners.organization_name: Teck Metals Ltd. (subsidiary of Teck Resources Limited)

alternative_names: Trail Operations smelting and refining complex
identity.facility_type: Integrated polymetallic (zinc–lead) smelting and refining complex with germanium recovery/refining
identity.short_description: Integrated zinc-lead smelting and refining complex at Trail, British Columbia — one of the world's largest fully integrated polymetallic smelter-refineries. Produces refined zinc, lead and silver plus ~19 products, and is Canada's only germanium producer and North America's only commercial-scale primary germanium recovery/refining operation (germanium dioxide and tetrachloride), recovering germanium as a byproduct of zinc processing, including from germanium-bearing zinc concentrate from Red Dog (Alaska).
identity.commissioning_or_operating_start_date: 1896 (first furnace; smelter operations continuous since ~1896, expanded and modernized over subsequent decades)

location.site_address: Trail, British Columbia, Canada (on the Columbia River, approx. 16 km north of the Canada–United States border)

operations.operating_configuration: Single integrated site with multiple interconnected metallurgical operations: an electrolytic zinc plant (roast-leach-electrowin plus direct pressure leaching), a KIVCET lead smelter with slag fuming, and downstream byproduct/specialty-metals recovery circuits (germanium, indium, cadmium, antimony, bismuth, silver, gold). Germanium recovery is metallurgically coupled to and fed by the zinc/lead smelting circuits.

operations.main_physical_function: Smelt and refine zinc and lead concentrates (including germanium-bearing Red Dog concentrate) into refined zinc, lead and silver, generating germanium/indium/cadmium-bearing zinc-oxide fume and residues as intermediates for byproduct recovery.

inputs.actual_input_quantity: Not disclosed at Trail level; Red Dog produced 462,700 t contained zinc in 2025 (mine output, not all delivered to Trail); germanium content not disclosed by Teck.

inputs.input_name: Zinc concentrate (third-party and other Teck sources)
Lead concentrate and recycled/secondary lead materials
inputs.input_form: sulphide lead concentrate / secondary lead-bearing materials

major_industrial_processes.process_or_stage_name: Electrolytic zinc production (roast-leach-electrowin + direct pressure leach)
major_industrial_processes.transformation_function: Convert zinc concentrate to refined zinc metal, mobilizing germanium/indium/cadmium into residues and solution for downstream recovery
major_industrial_processes.actual_process_or_technology_used: Fluid-bed roasting, atmospheric and direct pressure leaching, solution purification, and electrowinning
major_process_steps: Casting of refined zinc slab/jumbo and alloys
major_industrial_processes.output_form: refined zinc metal (slab/jumbo, alloys); leach residues

major_industrial_processes.process_or_stage_name: KIVCET lead smelting and slag fuming
major_industrial_processes.input_form: lead concentrate, flux, coke, internal recycles
major_industrial_processes.transformation_function: Smelt lead-bearing feed to lead bullion and fume off zinc/germanium/indium/cadmium-bearing oxide fume from slag
major_industrial_processes.actual_process_or_technology_used: KIVCET (oxygen flash cyclone electrothermal) single-stage flash smelting furnace followed by slag fuming furnace
major_process_steps: KIVCET flash smelting to lead bullion
Slag fuming to produce zinc-oxide fume

outputs_produced.output_name: Germanium/indium/cadmium-bearing zinc-oxide fume and leach residues

operation_metrics.capacity_utilization: ~85% of ~300,000 t nameplate in 2024; reduced to ~63–77% under 2025–2026 guidance (190,000–230,000 t)

operations.estimation_method: Not applicable — figures from Teck disclosures; utilization ratios derived from reported output vs. nameplate

operations.main_physical_function: Recover germanium from zinc-oxide fume and leach intermediates generated by the zinc/lead smelting circuits and refine it into germanium dioxide and germanium tetrachloride products.

major_industrial_processes.transformation_function: Leach fume and selectively precipitate/concentrate germanium into a germanium-rich intermediate
major_industrial_processes.actual_process_or_technology_used: Sodium-carbonate leaching to remove chlorine/fluorine; ferric hydroxide precipitation in neutral pachucas to precipitate germanium (with As and Sb); further purification

major_industrial_processes.process_or_stage_name: Germanium refining to dioxide and tetrachloride
major_industrial_processes.transformation_function: Refine and convert germanium intermediate into marketable germanium products
major_industrial_processes.actual_process_or_technology_used: Chlorination/distillation and hydrolysis to germanium tetrachloride and germanium dioxide (industry-standard germanium refining; specific Trail flowsheet not fully disclosed)

outputs_produced.output_name: Germanium products (germanium dioxide and germanium tetrachloride)
outputs_produced.nameplate_output_capacity: Not disclosed; announced expansion (Trail Strategic Metals Initiative) could double existing germanium production capacity, subject to definitive agreements (announced July 7, 2026)
outputs_produced.actual_output_quantity: Not disclosed by Teck (germanium content of concentrate and Trail's germanium output are proprietary). Context: global primary germanium production ~130 t/yr (USGS); Trail is North America's only commercial-scale primary producer and only supplier of germanium dioxide to the US.
outputs_produced.reporting_period: Not applicable (current); expansion timeline not established

outputs_produced.nameplate_output_capacity: Not disclosed; announced expansion could double antimony production capacity (July 7, 2026)

operation_metrics.quantity_basis: contained germanium in refined germanium products, annual

operations.reported_or_estimated: reported (qualitative); quantitative germanium output not disclosed
operations.estimation_method: Not applicable — Teck does not publicly disclose Trail germanium tonnage; multiple sources (Payne Institute, USGS) confirm the figure is proprietary. Commonly cited industry estimates of ~8–10 t/yr are not from a verifiable primary source and are therefore not asserted here.
